title: Page or total based
text: Give a page count, or a total and page size, and the pages are worked out.

title: Page size choice
text: An optional page size list lets users pick how many rows they see.

title: Compact page list
text: Sibling and boundary counts control which page numbers show around gaps.

title: Readable summary
text: A localized summary such as the shown range of the total, announced politely.
